newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker RGI proposes bonus share issue.
newsitem.headline: Aker RGI proposes bonus share issue.

text.p: Norwegian industrial holding company Aker RGI ASA said on Friday its board had proposed a bonus issue of B shares to help improve liquidity in the stock and allow it to be priced more effectively.

A company statement said the issue would comprise 12.87 million B shares at 20 crowns per share. The issue would increase the group's share capital by 257 million crowns to 1.544 billion crowns, it said.
It said shareholders would receive one new B share for each five A or B share already held.
